name: math_2_3
subject: Mathematics
substrand: Area of Part of a Circle

conflicts.fact: Sequencing of when the sector area formula is derived and when the proportionality is confirmed; Lessons 1 and 2 state it is learned/established early, while Lessons 3 and 4 treat it as to be derived later
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says no formula is formally taught but then writes A=(θ/360°)×πr² on the board and has students apply it; Lesson 2 formalises the formula and says it will be 'formally derived' in Lesson 3; Lesson 3 says the area formula comes in Lesson 4 and asks students to predict it; Lesson 4 derives it for the first time.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson contains the arc length derivation and the lesson numbering for application
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says arc length formula is derived in Lesson 3 and applied in Lessons 4 and 5; Lesson 3 follows that, but Lesson 2 says sector area applied in Lessons 4 and 5 while Lesson 5 is major sector and Lesson 8 is the real-life application.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 9 says segment area was done by learners in Lessons 6–8 with 'pizza/chapati slices', and Lesson 9 scenario (D) uses r=35 m, θ=150° while its model uses θ=60°
conflicts.versions: Lesson 9 Observe uses irrigation arc r=35 m, θ=150°; Lesson 9 Model Building uses irrigation arc r=35 m, θ=60°.

conflicts.fact: Slice angles of the original chapati/pizza
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: slices of about 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°, 135°, radius ≈15 cm; Lesson 8: the original chapati has slices labelled 40°, 55°, 70°, 80°, 115°.

conflicts.fact: When the proportionality was first established/confirmed
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 says it was confirmed with data in Lesson 2; Lesson 8 says the proportionality conjecture was first raised in Lesson 2 when students noticed wider slices appeared larger and was numerically confirmed only now in Lesson 8, whereas Lesson 4 also confirms it.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson started the cumulative model and what it is
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: initial model begun in Lesson 1; Lesson 5: 'circle-parts model begun in Lesson 2'; Lesson 10: 'concept maps started in Lesson 4'.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 8 states the cumulative model includes the segment construction from Lesson 7, while segment was introduced in Lesson 4 (as coming next) and Lesson 6; Lesson 8 prices differ by lessons
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8: model has segment construction 'from Lesson 7'; Lessons 4/6: segment annotation added in Lessons 4 and 6.

conflicts.fact: Meaning of the central angle for the minor segment vs. the Lesson 10 Part D numerical result
conflicts.versions: Lesson 10 Part D: 307.9 − 216.5 = 91.4 m², but ½·21²·sin80° = 217.1 (not 216.5), and the minor sector area for r=21, θ=80° is ≈ 307.9 m², arc length 29.33 m uses π=22/7 (80/360×2×22/7×21=29.33); the major sector 1077.6 = 1385.4 − 307.9 uses a different π (22/7 gives 1386, so 1078.1).
